entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit customer support. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I'm calling about my VeloBand Pulse. It's just... not working. I'm so confused by it. The readings seem wrong and frankly, the device feels like a piece of garbage.
I'm very sorry to hear that you're having trouble. So I can best assist you, can you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the device?
Yes, it's faulty. But look, I'm not a tech person. I don't have time to sit on the phone pressing buttons. I just want money back for it. I just want a refund.
I understand your frustration. Normally for a defect claim, our first step would be to connect you with our technical team to verify the issue. They're usually very quick.
No, please, I don't want to do that. The website was so complicated, and I'm just overwhelmed. Can't you just help me? I just want to send it back.
Okay, I understand. You'd prefer to just return the item without troubleshooting. Let me pull up our official return policy for you. Please hold one moment.
Thank you for waiting. Okay, I've checked our knowledge base, and it looks like VeloFit products are eligible for return within 90 days of the delivery date.
Oh. So... I can return it then? I got it 22 days ago.
Yes, absolutely. Since you're at day 22, you are well within that 90-day window. I can authorize this return for you right now and email you a prepaid shipping label.
Wow, really? That's such a relief. I was so worried it would be a big problem. Thank you so much, Sarah.

You're very welcome. I'm happy I could get this sorted out for you. The email with the label is on its way. Once we receive the band, your refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help. Thank you!
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
